title: Unctuous Indian Sausage Idli
description: A charred and gooey Indian dish featuring sausage, served in a idli form, perfect for adventurous eaters. This raw-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional idlis.

ingredients.name: Indian sausage
ingredients.notes: such as lamb or chicken sausage

instructions: Grind the idli rice and urad dal into a fine paste using a blender or food processor.
Mix the paste with yogurt, ghee, and a pinch of salt.
Chop the onion and ginger, and saute them in a pan until they are lightly browned.
Add the cumin seeds to the pan and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the Indian sausage to the pan, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the sausage is cooked, add it to the idli paste and mix well.
Pour the mixture into idli molds and steam them for 15 minutes.
Serve the idlis hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro and a dollop of yogurt.
